crons.comment: Every minute. Rotation: minute%5 → pair index. Each pair updated once per 5 minutes. 288 calls/day × 2 credits = 576/day (under 800 free limit). Full cycle: 5 minutes.
Every 6 hours. Polls RSS feeds and analyzes with AI (News layer).
Every 6 hours. NASA EONET storms and hurricanes.
Every 24 hours. Open-Meteo Air Quality heatmap.
Every 24 hours. Open-Meteo wind and temperature heatmap.
Every 24 hours. Open-Meteo Marine sea surface temperature heatmap.
Every 6 hours. Purges all data older than 3 days (72 hours).
